release_title: v1.0.2 - Offline Next Episode Navigation & Playback Position Fix
release_notes:
• Offline Next Episode: automatic discovery and seamless next/previous navigation across downloaded episodes directly in the offline folder
• Fixed episode advance position: clicking Next Episode now always starts cleanly from 0:00 instead of jumping to the end
• Player isolation: terminating player metrics are quarantined during stream transitions to prevent watch history corruption
• Full multi-ABI support for offline & in-app updates
